map.Δf = K_v·V_max；VCO 增益 K_v 单位 Hz/V。: Delta f = K_v V_max; VCO gain K_v is in Hz/V.
map.K_v=1 MHz/V、V_max=5V 时范围 ±5 MHz。: For K_v=1 MHz/V and V_max=5V the range is ±5 MHz.
map.VCO 增益 Kv × 最大控制电压 Vmax 得捕获/锁定频偏范围。: VCO gain Kv times maximum control voltage Vmax gives the capture/lock frequency-offset range.

map.锁定频偏 Δf = 1e6 × 5 = 5×10⁶ Hz = 5 MHz，即中心: Lock offset Delta f = 1e6 x 5 = 5x10^6 Hz = 5 MHz, i.e. lockable within ±5MHz of the center frequency.
map.若 Vmax=2V，则 Δf=2MHz，控制范围收窄，需更高 Kv 补偿。: If Vmax=2V, then Delta f=2MHz, the control range narrows and a higher Kv is needed to compensate.
map.锁定范围与捕获范围一样吗？: Is lock range the same as capture range?
map.通常捕获范围小于锁定（保持）范围，启动入锁要求更苛刻。: Usually the capture range is smaller than the lock (hold) range; initial acquisition is more demanding.
map.Kv 越大越好吗？: Is a larger Kv always better?
map.Kv 大可锁范围宽，但易受噪声与漂移影响，需环路滤波配合。: A larger Kv gives a wider lock range but is more susceptible to noise and drift, requiring loop filtering.
